identity.name: Vibes Weather
identity.theme_strategy: Dark Mode Only (Deep Midnight to Ice Blue)

glass.card: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border-white/20 shadow-lg hover:bg-white/15 transition-all duration-300

structure.container: max-w-[1600px] mx-auto p-4 md:p-8 h-screen overflow-hidden flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-6
structure.left_panel: w-full md:w-[350px] flex flex-col gap-6 shrink-0
structure.right_panel: w-full md:w-[300px] flex flex-col gap-6 shrink-0

glass_card.base_classes: rounded-3xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.36)]

weather_icon.size: w-16 h-16 or w-32 h-32 for hero

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, gradient fills, no grid lines or very subtle

map.style: Abstract, dark theme, neon highlights for active regions

glassmorphism.noise_texture: Use a subtle SVG noise overlay on the main background to reduce banding

transitions.card_entry: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Import 'Outfit' and 'DM Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css.
3. LAYOUT: Implement the 3-column layout (Left, Center, Right) strictly. On mobile, stack them.
4. GLASSMORPHISM: Create a reusable 'GlassCard' component that applies the base glass classes. ALL containers must use this.
5. BACKGROUND: The main app container must have the dynamic weather background image with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) to ensure text readability.
6. CHARTS: Use Recharts for the Hourly Forecast (LineChart) and Monthly Rainfall (BarChart). Style them to match the glass theme (transparent backgrounds, white axis text).
7. MAP: Create a placeholder or simple SVG map for the 'World Weather' section if a full library is too heavy, but style it with the neon accent colors.
8. DATA: Mock the weather data initially, but structure the state to easily swap with an API call later.
9. TABS: Use a custom tab component for the 7-day forecast that looks like floating glass pills.
10. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (search input, tabs, toggle buttons).
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use the specified deep midnight gradients.
Ensure all text on glass backgrounds has sufficient contrast. Use drop-shadow-sm on white text if needed.
Micro-interactions are mandatory. Buttons should glow on hover.
